audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is inverted in six of seven stages, in BOTH layers. content.win[0..3] and full.phases[0..3].side say 'Kayle', while content.whys[0] says 'You dominate level 1 - Kayle is a melee hyperscaler with no early trade' and spikes[0] says 'You bully pre-6 hard'. content.win[5]/win[6] and phases[5]/[6].side say 'Skill', while whys[5] says 'Kayle's ranged form spike tips the lane to her' and whys[6] says 'she hyperscales'. Only stage 5 (Skill at level 6) was right.
audit.why: The packet levelChart is [Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Dr. Mundo, Skill, Kayle, Kayle]. Every prose field on the page already agrees with it; only the side tokens were reversed. Kayle is melee with a single 12-second slow until her wings grant Attack Range, and she out-ranges and out-damages Mundo once they do - that is the shape both the packet and the whys describe. The full-layer phase whys had also drifted (phases[3] told you Kayle 'watches you out-scale', phases[6] called you a raid boss she cannot handle) which is backwards for a hyperscaler.
audit.corrected: Whole-chart flip proposed as one group: content win[0..3] Kayle -> Dr. Mundo, win[5]/win[6] Skill -> Kayle; full phases[0..3].side -> Dr. Mundo (ratings 2/2/3/3 -> 7/7/7/7), phases[5].side -> Kayle (6 -> 4), phases[6].side -> Kayle (5 -> 3), and all six whys rewritten to match. Also fixed breakdown.spikes, breakdown.late and report[2].t, which listed Mundo's windows as Kayle's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four errors. (1) report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns state Divine Judgment is 100s; the kit says 160/120/80. (2) tradeGood, phases[2].why and report[11].t are built on Mundo's passive canister popping when she CCs him - Kayle has no immobilizing effect at all, only Radiant Blast's slow, so the canister never drops in this lane. (3) Radiant Blast reducing resistances is never mentioned anywhere, and it is the single reason her follow-up damage spikes. (4) Starfire Spellblade scaling with MISSING health is never mentioned, and it is the exact mechanic that punishes how Mundo plays. Also the full layer calls his Q a 'cleaver' and his E 'Blunt Force' rather than Blunt Force Trauma, and uses 'his/him' for Kayle in six fields.
audit.why: Riot on Radiant Blast: 'slowing, damaging, and reducing the resistances of all hit' - it is 12/11/10/9/8s at 900 range, so it is both her only slow and the multiplier on everything after it. Riot on Starfire Spellblade: 'dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health', 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s and free. Dr. Mundo lives at low health by design - Maximum Dosage heals a percent of MISSING health - so the lower he goes, the harder her auto-reset lands. And Riot on Goes Where He Pleases: it resists the first Immobilizing effect; a slow is not one.
audit.corrected: Corrected Divine Judgment to 160/120/80 in report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns. Replaced the canister-based tradeGood, phases[2].why and report[11].t with the real mechanics. Wrote Radiant Blast's resistance shred into report[5].t, tradeGood, dontsFull[1].d and spikes[2].text, and Starfire Spellblade's missing-health scaling into tradeBad, dosFull[1], breakdown.cooldowns and loading. Renamed cleaver -> Infected Bonesaw and Blunt Force -> Blunt Force Trauma, and fixed her pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags it directly: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere', sequencingCues 0. Every 'track her cooldown' line named Divine Judgment, which at 160s is not something you sequence around in lane, and gave no number at all for the spells you actually trade against.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown in this lane is Radiant Blast, 12s at rank 1 - it is her only slow, her only disengage and her resistance shred. The 12 seconds after she throws it is a window in which she cannot kite a Mundo who is walking at her. Divine Judgment is the all-in gate at 160/120/80s, and Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with Radiant Blast 12/11/10/9/8s, Starfire Spellblade 8s->6s, Celestial Blessing 15s and Maximum Dosage 120s, and re-keyed winCon, loading, dosFull[0], report[1], report[9] and report[10] to 'wait out Radiant Blast, then walk at her'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization named Grievous Wounds only as something Kayle needs against Mundo, never as something Mundo wants against her.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15-second heal on her and her nearest ally, and Kayle auto-attacks you constantly. Bramble Vest applies Grievous Wounds to anyone who basic-attacks you, so it is free anti-heal in this specific matchup rather than an active purchase you have to land.
audit.corrected: report[8].t rewritten to add Bramble Vest early and tie it to Celestial Blessing's 15s.
